title: Settings
subtitle: Broker profile, team and document library

noPermission.title: No access
noPermission.description: Your role cannot see this section. Talk to your brokerage administrator.

profile.title: Broker profile
profile.description: Your organization's master data, as the rest of the platform sees it.
profile.empty: We could not load your organization
profile.editSoon: Editing the broker profile is coming soon

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Stored as a broker document and converted to WEBP 512×512.
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WEBP. It is cropped to a square.

account.title: My profile
account.description: Your contact details inside the brokerage.
account.emailReadOnly: Your email is your identifier and cannot be changed here
account.noEditPermission: Your role cannot edit this profile

password.title: Password
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one

team.title: Team
team.description: The users of your brokerage and the role they sign in with.
team.roleDescription: The role defines what this person can see and do. You may only grant roles from your own actor family.
team.deactivateDescription: The user can no longer sign in. Nothing is deleted: their documents and activity are kept.
team.activateDescription: The user can sign in again with their credentials.

invite.title: Invite user
invite.description: The account is created inside your brokerage. If you leave the password empty we generate a temporary one.
invite.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password
invite.tempDescription: Shown only once. Copy it and hand it to {{name}}.
invite.duplicate: A user with that email already exists

documents.title: Documents & media
documents.description: Every file of the brokerage. Storage is the single source of S3 paths.
documents.renameDescription: The stored file does not change, only its record.
documents.name: Display name
documents.deleteDescription: The file is removed from the registry and from storage. This cannot be undone.
documents.uploadDescription: The file is attached to your brokerage. To attach it to a client, asset or proposal, do it from that record.

guard.noPermission: You do not have permission for this action
guard.self: You cannot do this to your own account
guard.adminOnly: Only a brokerage administrator can change this.

error.generic: We could not complete the action
error.load: We could not load the data

schemas.title: Schemas by line
schemas.description: Define what records the AI normalizes for each insurance line.
schemas.empty: No schemas yet. Create the first one for your main line.
schemas.readOnlyGlobal: Radal's global schema cannot be edited; create your own for your brokerage.

form.description: A schema is sections and fields. Keys are English identifiers; labels are what you see on screen.
form.name: Schema name
form.noLines: The brokerage has no active lines yet.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Guidance for the AI and the user
form.needSection: Add at least one section with a field.
form.totalsHint: Sums the amount (UF) columns at the foot of the table (locations × insured-matters matrix).

schemas.deleteDescription: The schema will be deleted. Already-registered expedientes are unchanged.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: A line is the ramo plus the records it requests. Define your own or adopt a recommended template.
lines.empty: You have no lines yet. Create one from a template or from scratch.
lines.deleteInUse: In use by {{count}} account(s); cannot delete.
lines.deleteDescription: The line will be deleted. Already-registered expedientes are unchanged.

picker.title: Create line
picker.description: Start from a recommended template (you can edit it) or build the line from scratch.
picker.fromScratchHint: Create an empty line and define its sections and fields.

version.copyHint: Copy the version to report a problem

collectionsTab.description: How your brokerage collects: when it reminds, how much difference it accepts and which mailbox it writes from. Applies to the whole brokerage.
collectionsTab.noView: Your role cannot see the collections settings.
collectionsTab.readOnly: Only an administrator can change the collections settings.

cadence.title: Cadence
cadence.description: The days, counted from each installment's due date, when Radal notifies you and, if reminders are on, writes to the policyholder.
cadence.hint: Negative = before the due date · 0 = the day · positive = after. Between −90 and 180, no repeats, up to 10 days.
cadence.invalid: Enter a whole number between −90 and 180
cadence.duplicate: That day is already in the cadence
cadence.full: The cadence allows up to 10 days
cadence.empty: The cadence needs at least one day
cadence.termRisk: After the last day, the policy is flagged at risk of termination.

followup.label: Follow-up period for proposals and endorsements
followup.hint: Days without an insurer reply before you are notified.

tolerance.title: Tolerances
tolerance.description: Maximum difference between paid and billed to consider an installment paid.

notices.title: Policyholder reminders
notices.description: Automatic emails to the policyholder (or payer) on each cadence day.
notices.needsApproval: Approve the messages below before turning reminders on.
notices.pausedUntilApproved: Reminders are paused until the messages below are approved. You can still save the rest of the settings.
notices.senderAccountRequired: Choose the mailbox reminders are sent from
notices.senderNoAccounts: No connected mailbox sends mail. Connect one in the Mail tab.
notices.senderNoMailView: Your role cannot see the mailboxes.

native.title: Online payment
native.enabled: Offer online payment when the insurer allows it
native.hint: When off, every installment is collected in assisted mode.

inquiries.title: Insurer inquiries
inquiries.enabled: Automatically ask the insurer for the payment status
inquiries.hint: Radal writes to the insurer when an installment still has no recorded payment; its reply becomes a suggestion to confirm.

validation.fixFields: Check the highlighted fields before saving.

templates.title: Collection messages
templates.description: The text of each notice. Each message is approved separately: an unapproved one is not sent, approved ones keep going out.
templates.notApproved: Not approved: no reminder is sent until you approve the messages.
templates.savedNeedsApproval: Messages saved. The edited ones stay unapproved until you approve them; the others keep sending.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.activeHint: An inactive message is not sent.
templates.variablesHint: Tap a variable to insert it at the cursor.
templates.unknownVariables: Unknown variables: {{list}}. Radal cannot replace them.
templates.inquiryToken: The insurer inquiry subject must keep [RADAL-{{inquiry_token}}]: that is how Radal recognises the reply.
templates.missingHint: Those days notify your team but do not write to the policyholder.

var.share_url: Link to view and pay the installments
var.installments_table: Table of the installments asked about

sample.insurer_instructions: Transfer to Banco de Chile, checking 00-123-45678-9, RUT 99.999.999-9.
sample.paid_note: We have already recorded a payment of UF 20,20 of UF 45,20.

templates.approvedOneToast: Message approved: it can be sent now
templates.approveOneDirty: Save this message's changes before approving it.
templates.someUnapproved_one: {{count}} unapproved message: that notice is not sent until you approve it. The others keep going out.
templates.someUnapproved_other: {{count}} unapproved messages: those notices are not sent until you approve them. The others keep going out.
templates.unapprovedOne: Not approved: this notice is not sent until you approve it.
templates.editedWillUnapprove: Unsaved changes: once saved, this message stays unapproved until you approve it. The others are not affected.

insurersTab.description: How each insurer is paid and which email receives inquiries. What you fill in here overrides what Radal has on record.
insurersTab.noView: Your role cannot see the per-insurer payment settings.
insurersTab.empty: No insurers with your policies yet.
insurersTab.levelNative: Online payment available with this insurer.
insurersTab.levelAssisted: Assisted collection: Radal reminds, asks the insurer and you confirm.
insurersTab.noInstructions: No payment instructions. Add them so they reach the reminders.
insurersTab.noEmail: No email: inquiries cannot be sent.
insurersTab.editReason: Only an administrator can customise an insurer's collection.

sheet.title: Collecting with {{name}}
sheet.description: Leave a field blank to use the value Radal has.
sheet.collectionsEmailHint: Payment status inquiries go to this email.
sheet.instructionsHint: Shown in policyholder reminders and in the share link.
sheet.nativeEnabled: Use online payment with this insurer when available
sheet.invalidUrl: Must start with http:// or https://
sheet.invalidRut: Invalid RUT: check the verification digit.

integrationsTab.description: Radal's connections with the insurers' portals.

portals.title: Quote on portals
portals.description: Radal logs into the insurer's portal with your credentials, quotes and brings you the results.
portals.credentialsReason: Only an administrator can save portal credentials.
portals.noAccess: Your role has no access to Quote on portals.

tabsLocked: Your role has no access to: {{tabs}}. Ask a brokerage administrator for access.
tabLockedHint: Your role has no access to this section.
readOnlyBanner: Read only: your role can see these settings, but only a brokerage administrator can change them.
